headlines.title: T-Mobile Doubles Down on the Power of Brand, Unveiling a Next-Generation Creative Ecosystem
headlines.summary: BELLEVUE, Wash., November 02, 2026--T-Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS) today unveiled the next evolution of its brand and creative ecosystem, appointing Anomaly as strategic brand transformation partner, naming Highdive lead creative advertising agency and advancing AI-enabled creative production through its in-house T-Studios.

headlines.title: SpaceX reportedly wants to buy Boost Mobile to compete with AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon
headlines.summary: SpaceX has been looking for new ways to use its Starlink network, and a tie-up with cellular operator Boost Mobile could give it the terrestrial access it needs.

headlines.title: T-Mobile Opens Up on Its Cybersecurity Transformation in New Report
Verizon Communications (VZ) Explores Free Mobile Internet Through Tower Data Services
headlines.summary: Verizon Communications (NYSE:VZ), AT&T, and T-Mobile are assessing a model where mobile internet access could eventually be offered at no direct cost to users. The three carriers are exploring ways to use cellphone towers for advanced monitoring and data services as an alternative revenue source. Industry executives are evaluating how tower-based services could contribute recurring income that offsets traditional wireless subscription fees.

headlines.title: T-Mobile Fiber Unveils Its Fastest Plan Yet — 5 Gig with a 10-year Price Guarantee
headlines.summary: BELLEVUE, Wash., November 02, 2026--T-Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS) today announced T-Mobile Fiber is launching its fastest plan yet, bringing customers 5 Gig fiber internet backed by a 10-year price guarantee. Built for busy, connected households, 5 Gig is made to keep up when everyone — and everything — is online at once, with an internet price customers can count on for a decade. The Fiber 5 Gig plan is available starting tomorrow, November 3, for $90 a month with AutoPay, plus taxes and fees.

description: T-Mobile US, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides wireless communications services in the United States, Puerto Rico, and the United States Virgin Islands. The company offers voice, messaging, and data services to postpaid, prepaid, and wholesale and other services customers. It also provides wireless devices, including smartphones, wearables, tablets, home broadband gateways, headsets, and other mobile communication devices, as well as accessories; financing through equipment installment plans; reinsurance for device insurance policies and extended warranty contracts. The company offers services under the T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile brands through its owned and operated retail stores, customer care channels, national retailers, and its websites, as well as through T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile apps. It also sells devices to dealers and other third-party distributors for resale through independent third-party retail outlets and various third-party websites. It has 700 MHz wireless spectrum licenses. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. T-Mobile US, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Deutsche Telekom AG.
